_doc: Test prompts for iterating on this skill with skill-creator. Replace <APP_REPO> with a real checkout on your machine. Each assertion is checked after the run (see README, Testing the skill).

evals.name: rn-screen-matrix
evals.prompt: I want to see how the Wishlist (or any list) screen in our React Native app looks on small and big iPhones, a Pixel, and the iPhone Duo cover and open screens, in English and Arabic. The repo is at <APP_REPO>. Use realistic data, not lorem ipsum. Give me contact sheets and a short list of anything that looks broken.
evals.expected_output: A react-native-web harness built from the skill templates in a clean workspace, the real screen rendered with realistic data on iphone-se, iphone-17-pro-max, pixel-9, duo-cover, duo-open-l (EN + AR), contact sheets, and a short verified findings list with code refs.
assertions: app checkout untouched (same HEAD, clean git status)
harness built from the skill templates
small iPhone, big iPhone, Pixel, Duo cover and Duo open shots exist
most renders have no page errors and no api misses
findings cite code file:line and screenshots
no em or en dashes in deliverables

evals.name: web-app-mobile-check
evals.prompt: Our internal web app (<APP_REPO>, a Next.js monorepo) needs a mobile check before a new foldable launches. Render its main pages on iPhone SE, iPhone 15, a Galaxy S24, Galaxy Fold and the iPhone Duo cover and open screens, plus a 1920 desktop, and Arabic if the app supports it. Mock whatever API it calls. Send me contact sheets and a report.
evals.expected_output: The web app running from a clean copy, its main pages rendered with mocked API data (mock server if data is fetched server-side) on the requested profiles, contact sheets, and report.html + issues.csv with verified findings, including unreachable controls and horizontal overflow flagged by the harness.
assertions: app checkout untouched (same HEAD, clean git status)
app run from a clean copy
iPhone SE, iPhone 15, Galaxy S24, Galaxy Fold, Duo cover and open, and desktop shots exist
Arabic rendered or its absence explained
most renders have no page errors and no api misses
no em or en dashes in deliverables
